# Documentation templates

Status: maintained reference. Owner: TRACE maintainers. Updated: 2026-10-31.

- [Feature specification](feature.md): expected behavior and executable acceptance scenarios.
- [Architecture decision](decision.md): context, choice, consequences, alternatives, and revisit condition.
- [Release evidence](release.md): revisions, checks, artifact, deployment, and remaining gates.

Copy only the relevant template, replace placeholders, and link the result from its owning index. The [workflow](../development/workflow.md) defines completion and review. Templates are not feature or release evidence.
